Rollback would use `git checkout`, so no temp copy is needed. **Classifying each finding.** Every finding has check `paths-exist` and reason `Modify: path "

If the brief came from a file, its path goes here instead. 2. `phase_tracker start implement`. The `plan_check` stamp is current from the PASS. 3. No `substep` call, because the brief shows `→ implement` with no substep. 4. Feasibility validation before `init`: - Pending-suffix order holds (✓ ✓ ✓ → ○). - Not every task is complete or skipped, so implement will not auto-complete. 5. `plan_tracker init` with: ``` [{name: "W1: Inventory legacy parsers", status: "complete"}, {name: "W1: Delete legacy/parsers tree", status: "complete"}, {name: "W1: Delete legacy/fixtures tree", status: "complete"}, {name: "W2: Point imports at the new parser", status: "in_progress"}, {name: "W3: Update the parser guide", status: "pending"}] ``` **Printed lines:** ``` Repaired plan: 400 findings (paths-exist) Gate history not restored; re-validating `W2: Point imports at the new parser` before any stage advance ```
